sourceProvenance.geometryOrigin: Original parametric standalone shirt geometry; provenance states no source outfit mesh was imported or modified.

garmentTypeAndCoverage.observation: All four views read as a standalone long-sleeve shirt with front placket, front buttons, collar pieces, and cuff buttons. No mannequin or body is visible.

silhouetteAndVolume.observation: The front and back body panels and sleeves have readable volume; the side and oblique views confirm depth. The shoulder joins and collar construction still need correction.

shoulderJoins.observation: The back view shows dark open-looking gaps and thin protruding surfaces at both shoulder/cap joins; the defects remain visible from the oblique angle.

collarConstruction.observation: The front and oblique views show a cylindrical stand with sharply triangular leaves that appear separated from the stand and chest, so the collar does not read as a clean, joined office-shirt collar.

naturalFabricFolds.observation: The shirt has broad volume, but the front and back torso read almost uniformly smooth; natural fabric folds are not discernible in the neutral gray views.

findings.observation: Dark open-looking gaps and thin protruding surfaces are visible at both joins in the back capture and remain apparent in the oblique capture.
findings.expected: Join the back panel, shoulder caps, and sleeves into a clean continuous shoulder/armhole transition with no visible gaps or stray surfaces.

findings.observation: The collar reads as a cylindrical neck band with sharply triangular leaves separated from the stand/chest, rather than a joined office-shirt collar.
findings.expected: Refine the stand and attach the collar leaves cleanly to it and the shirt front, with a recognizable, proportionate shirt-collar shape.

findings.observation: The torso surfaces look almost uniformly smooth in the gray captures; the required natural fabric folds are not readable.
findings.expected: Add restrained, natural garment folds to the torso while preserving the regular-fit silhouette and clean panels.

summary: QA độc lập trả ATEL-47/v1 cho một vòng correction tối đa ba điểm: khe/miếng nhô ở hai vai sau, cổ chưa liền thành cổ sơ mi rõ ràng, và nếp vải tự nhiên chưa đọc được. Hash GLB/provenance/captures khớp manifest; áo đọc là sơ mi tay dài độc lập, có khuy trước/cổ tay và không mannequin. Chưa duyệt shape, chưa chuyển Material.
